sentences.text:
Heard on I.A.No.20087/2025, second application filed under Section 389(1) Cr.P.C. for grant of interim suspension of sentence and bail on behalf of appellant- Arbaz Khan on the ground of attending marriage of his younger sister.
2.

This criminal appeal assails the judgment dated 07/05/2025 whereby present appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Section. imprisonment fine In de  366 of IPC 10 years' RI Rs. 1000/- one ye  376 (D) of IPC 20 years' RI Rs.50,000/- three y  392 IPC 05 years' RI Rs.1,000/- one yea 3 .

It is the submission of learned counsel for the appellant that marriage of his younger sister is going to be solemnized on 27/10/2025 and being elder brother, appellant has to perform some rituals in the marriage, therefore, he may kindly be granted interim suspension for a period of 15 days so that he can attend marriage of his sister.

4 . Factum regarding marriage of sister of appellant has been verified by the State counsel, however,
she submits that if this Court intends to release the appellant for the time being, then looking to the nature of allegations, certain stringent conditions may kindly be imposed upon him.
Considering the aforesaid submissions, application is allowed.

If appellant-Arbaz Khan furnishes a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) along with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/CJM Court/Remand Court, then his jail sentence shall remain temporarily suspended from 26/10/2025 to 28/10/2025.

Appellant shall be released on temporary bail on 26/10/2025 and he shall surrender on or before 28/10/2025 before the concerned Trial Court/ Remand Court and report shall be sent Arbaz vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21235066/
1 to this Court about the said fact.
